name: Little Flower Hospital
summary: Little Flower Hospital and Research Centre is a 610-bed charitable hospital in Angamaly that began in 1936. Its ophthalmology department, started in 1964, runs an eye bank and is a research centre approved by the Indian Council of Medical Research.
highlights: Began in 1936; 610 beds; registered as a charitable trust
Eye bank and a separate eye appointments line
Approved centre of the Indian Council of Medical Research for ophthalmology research
Research centre approved by the Kerala University of Health Sciences
